caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt composed of many irregularly shaped patches, each with distinct colors and embroidered patterns. The colors in the quilt include a mix of greens, blues, reds, purples, yellows, and pinks, with some patches containing floral designs and others containing decorative geometric stitching or script-like writing in various colors. The patches are outlined by stitched borders, some of which are highlighted with contrasting thread. The overall composition is densely packed, with no apparent regular pattern to the arrangement of the patches. The quilt is shown set against a plain, off-white or beige background, with no other objects present in the drawing. There is some faint text and marking along the bottom edge of the image outside the quilt's border.
title: Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
